Quickstart guide
from pinecone import Pinecone

pc = Pinecone("<API KEY>")

pc.Index("semantic-search")

index.query(
   namespace="breaking-news"
   vector=[0.13, 0.45, 1.34, ...],
   filter={"category": {"$eq": "technology"}},
   top_k=3
)
